name: wisedo-engine
description: Wisedo decision engine (Layer 1 + Layer 2) and its demo Worker: category configs, synthetic data, SKU store API.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-isolation.mjs && sh web/build.sh dist && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:remote: node scripts/check-isolation.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply wisedo-engine-exp-1 --remote
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/check-isolation.mjs --env staging && sh web/build.sh dist && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:remote:staging: node scripts/check-isolation.mjs --env staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply wisedo-engine-exp-1-staging --remote --env staging
